name: Draft documents

does: Keeps first drafts of plans, patent-style descriptions and legal-style documents that a person asked for, with every version stored
Stamps every draft with a banner saying it is a draft, not advice, and not yet used anywhere
Checks each draft has the sections its kind needs and no secret values, and refuses a draft that claims to be final, advice or already used
Flags drafts nobody has touched for a while so they are revised or closed
does_not: Give legal, patent or financial advice, or say a document is valid, enforceable or ready to use
Sign, send or submit any document anywhere: this pack has no outbound path
Mark a draft as used by anyone but the person who took it
Bypass the draft banner or the guard

charter.objective: Turn what a person asked for into clearly marked first drafts they can take to a qualified professional, and never let a draft pass as final

primary_metric.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drafts_versions WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

guard_metrics.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drafts_versions WHERE body NOT LIKE 'DRAFT, NOT FINAL.%'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drafts WHERE status = 'draft' AND updated_at < datetime('now', '-30 days')

enable_gate: Turn on Draft documents? It will keep first drafts of plans, patent-style descriptions and legal-style documents that you ask for, every version saved, each stamped as a draft that is not advice and has not been used anywhere. It cannot sign, send or submit anything, and it never says a document is valid or ready. Take a draft to a qualified professional before relying on it. It costs only the model calls you allow for writing, which can be none. Turn it off any time with one action.
